description: Adds (a) conversational slot-filling intake for shutdown requests, (b) a deterministic scheduling rules engine enforcing Singapore-holiday blackout, working-day spacing, and no-Friday-start, (c) emergency preemption with auto-proposed rescheduling of displaced planned ops, and (d) a month-view calendar UI in the React webapp.

locked_decisions.festive_blackout_scope: ALL 11 Singapore public holidays (incl. in-lieu Mondays), +/-7 calendar days each
locked_decisions.emergency_displacement: auto-propose next valid slot for displaced planned ops; user confirms before commit
locked_decisions.emergency_rule_bypass: emergencies bypass ALL scheduling rules (no-Friday, 3-working-day gap, holiday blackout)
locked_decisions.planned_booking: feasible planned request is booked into the calendar AFTER explicit user confirmation (not check-only, not silent)

scheduling_rules.R1_holiday_blackout: No PLANNED op within +/-7 calendar days of any of the 11 SG public holidays (actual or in-lieu date).
scheduling_rules.R2_working_day_gap: ALL PLANNED ops must have >=3 working days clear before the next scheduled operation. Working day = Mon-Fri excluding public holidays.
scheduling_rules.R3_no_friday_start: PLANNED op may not START on a Friday; engine proposes the following Monday.
scheduling_rules.E1_emergency_bypass: EMERGENCY ops ignore R1/R2/R3; schedulable anytime.
scheduling_rules.E2_emergency_preempt: EMERGENCY preempts any overlapping PLANNED op.
scheduling_rules.E3_emergency_reschedule: Each displaced PLANNED op gets an auto-proposed next valid slot (satisfying R1-R3), surfaced for user confirmation, then rebooked.

tech_stack_touched.rules_engine: pure Python stdlib (datetime) - NO LLM, deterministic, unit-tested
tech_stack_touched.ui: React + Vite (existing frontend/) - new month-grid CalendarView, no new npm dependency (custom grid)

sg_public_holidays.json.note: observed = in-lieu Monday when holiday falls on Sunday. Editable config; never hardcode in logic.

scheduled_operations_migration.add_column: operation_class TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PLANNED'  -- PLANNED | EMERGENCY
scheduled_operations_migration.rationale: operation_type (SHUTDOWN/INSPECTION/...) is orthogonal to planned-vs-emergency; needs its own column.

functions: blackout_dates(years) -> set[date]   # +/-7d around each holiday incl observed
validate_planned(start: datetime, end: datetime, existing_ops: list) -> ValidationResult{ok: bool, violations: list[str]}
next_valid_slot(desired_start: datetime, duration_h: float, existing_ops: list) -> datetime
find_displaced(emergency_start: datetime, emergency_end: datetime, existing_ops: list) -> list[op]

api_endpoints.description: List ops; add ?start=&end= range filter + operation_class in response for calendar month view
Reschedule a displaced operation to a new confirmed slot
Return SG holidays + blackout dates for a year (calendar shading)
